title: EnDive: A Cross-Dialect Benchmark for Fairness and Performance in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance and accuracy of LLMs across 12 natural language understanding and reasoning tasks when inputs are presented in Standard American English versus five underrepresented English dialects (African American Vernacular English, Indian English, Jamaican English, Chicano English, and Colloquial Singaporean English) generated via few-shot prompting.
